name: falcon-sdrift-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is falcon, a Python framework for building REST APIs and web applications
(WSGI and ASGI): request and response objects, URI and query-string utilities, routing with field
converters, cookie handling, media-type negotiation and media handlers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is falcon's request/response layer: the packages falcon/util/, falcon/routing/, falcon/media/ (with its validators) and falcon/cyutil/; the modules falcon/request.py, falcon/request_helpers.py, falcon/response.py, falcon/response_helpers.py, falcon/uri.py, falcon/forwarded.py, falcon/stream.py, falcon/constants.py and falcon/asgi_spec.py; the ASGI modules falcon/asgi/__init__.py, falcon/asgi/request.py, falcon/asgi/response.py, falcon/asgi/_request_helpers.py, falcon/asgi/_asgi_helpers.py, falcon/asgi/structures.py, falcon/asgi/reader.py, falcon/asgi/stream.py and falcon/asgi/multipart.py; together with the pages docs/api/util.rst, docs/api/routing.rst, docs/api/cookies.rst, docs/api/media.rst, docs/api/multipart.rst, docs/api/request_and_response.rst, docs/api/request_and_response_wsgi.rst and docs/api/request_and_response_asgi.rst and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation
